summary: SinghGyanAcademy - All India Mega Education Platform covering UPSC/State PCS, School Education (all classes/boards), SSC, Railway, Police, Teaching, Banking, Defence exams with AI Learning features
architectural_notes: Multi-section education platform architecture with 14 major exam categories
Hierarchical navigation: Main Menu → Exam Categories → Sub-exams → Content Types (Syllabus, Notes, Videos, Test Series)
AI-powered learning features integrated throughout platform
YouTube integration for video content delivery
Tagline: 'Ek Kadam Nishulk Shiksha Ki Aur - India's Smart Learning Platform'
Future expansion planned: Student Login, Mobile App, Paid Courses, Live Classes, AI Performance Tracking
